title: Founder Rules Worksheet
description: Define your operating rules for time, money, and decision-making before you start testing.

fields.label: Weekly hours commitment
fields.helperText: The honest number you can sustain week after week, not the ambitious number.

fields.label: Your work schedule
fields.placeholder: e.g., Tuesday and Thursday evenings 7-9pm, Saturday morning 9-11am
fields.helperText: Specific days and times, not 'whenever I get a chance'.

fields.label: Weekly review day
fields.helperText: When will you review progress and plan the week ahead?

fields.label: Monthly maximum budget
fields.helperText: The total amount you can spend each month without financial stress.

fields.label: Budget split: Tools vs Testing
fields.helperText: How will you divide your monthly budget?

fields.label: Your stop rule
fields.placeholder: e.g., I will stop if nobody shows interest after three weeks of active testing.
fields.helperText: What results would tell you to try a different idea? Be specific.

fields.label: Your continue rule
fields.placeholder: e.g., I will continue if I get questions and engagement but sales are slow.
fields.helperText: What early signs mean give it more time?

fields.label: Your invest more rule
fields.placeholder: e.g., I will invest more if I make consistent sales within my first month of listing.
fields.helperText: What results justify increasing time, budget, or effort?

fields.label: Your data over ego commitment
fields.placeholder: e.g., I commit to following the evidence even when it contradicts my personal attachment to an idea.
fields.helperText: Write this in your own words. The act of writing it down makes it real.

fields.label: Your red-line rules
fields.helperText: Select the non-negotiables that feel right for you, and add your own.

defaultOptions.label: I will not skip my weekly review.
I will not add a new tool without removing one I am not using.
I will not increase spending beyond my monthly cap without hitting escalation criteria.
I will track every expense and every sale from day one.

fields.label: Tax and registration notes
fields.placeholder: e.g., Need to check self-registration requirements in UK by end of month.
fields.helperText: Any notes about tax, self-employment registration, or compliance to look into.
